verdict.rationale: Sentry's pricing pages document its own custom dashboards across tiers (10 on Free, 20 on the next tier, unlimited on higher plans), and a Releases product exists. However, the evidence never describes what those dashboards can show: no error-trend widgets, cross-project or per-team views, regression lists, or new-issues-per-release breakdowns. missing for 10: documented error volume-over-time charts, cross-project/team aggregation, top-regression views, new-issues-per-release reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration of dashboard analytics.
